topic: Top 15 car producing countries by annual motor vehicle production, 1950 to 2025

interpretations.label: Total Motor Vehicles
interpretations.description: Total number of manufactured motor vehicles including passenger cars, light commercial vehicles, trucks, buses, and coaches.
interpretations.measurableDefinition: Total count of vehicles produced per calendar year (Units)
caveats: Includes both passenger cars and commercial vehicles which can blur distinctions in heavy truck-heavy countries.

interpretations.label: Passenger Cars Only
interpretations.description: Total number of dedicated passenger cars (excluding commercial vehicles and light trucks) manufactured per calendar year.
interpretations.measurableDefinition: Total count of passenger cars produced per calendar year (Units)
caveats: Excludes light commercial vehicles which are classified differently in certain national reporting standards.

preferredSources: International Organization of Motor Vehicle Manufacturers (OICA)
National Automotive Industry Associations (e.g., VDA, JAMA, CAAM)
UN Economic Commission for Europe (UNECE) Historical Transport Statistics
knownRisks: Inconsistent reporting standards and definitions of 'motor vehicle' across countries prior to 1970
Geopolitical boundary changes and dissolution of states (e.g., Soviet Union, Czechoslovakia, Yugoslavia) impacting historical time series continuity
